steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Work out each checking account's tenure from the current time and its date_opened. Open the savings account BEFORE closing a checking account when the one the customer wants to close is the only active checking account open at least 14 days. Explain why without exposing internal tool details: savings needs an active checking account held at least 14 days, and the remaining one is too new. If the customer pushes back or asks to close first, give this reason again rather than just insisting.
steps.if: the customer wants both to close a checking account and to open savings
steps.quote: Confirm an active checking account exists and meets the 14-day tenure requirement.

steps.do: Check every eligibility item. (1) There is an active checking account held at least 14 days; one opened in this conversation does not count, but an older active checking account does. (2) The customer has fewer than 5 personal savings accounts. (3) No account is in collections and none has a negative balance. If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, tell them they have reached the maximum and stop. If any account is in collections or negative, tell them it must be resolved first and stop.
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: Explain that opening a personal savings account requires an active Rho-Bank checking account. Do not open the savings account, and stop.
steps.if: get_accounts shows no active checking account
steps.quote: Customer has at least one active Rho-Bank checking account.

steps.do: Tell the customer the date they will become eligible: 14 days after the earliest active checking account's date_opened. Do not open the account.
steps.if: no active checking account has at least 14 days of tenure
steps.quote: Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

steps.do: If the customer already accepted a savings account earlier in this conversation (for example, from recommend_credit_card_and_savings_account_combination), skip gather_needs and recommend. Go straight to confirm_class with that account's full official name.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and already accepted a savings account recommended earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Before you recommend anything, ask about the customer's savings needs: withdrawals per month, the balance they can keep and their maximum, compounding, ATM rebates, relationship bonus, minimum APY and goals tracking.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Compare every personal savings account against the customer's needs and recommend ONE that meets all of them. Exclude any account that fails a need: its opening deposit or ongoing minimum is above the customer's maximum; its free withdrawals are below the customer's monthly count; it lacks ATM rebates the customer needs; or its APY at the customer's balance is below their target. Only Silver Plus Account matches 12–15 withdrawals/month, a relationship bonus, a $2,500–$4,000 balance with nothing near $10,000, daily compounding, ATM fee rebates and savings goals tracking. It is also the only match for frequent withdrawals (3–4 a week), a $5,000–$7,000 balance, daily compounding, ATM rebates and at least 3% APY. Its Tier 1 rate is 3.0% below $15,000, and Gold needs $10,000. Eco and premium requests are side wishes that don't fit the hard needs. If the customer asks for one answer, give one. Mention the $1,000 opening deposit, the $2,500 minimum balance and the $8.00 fee below that.
steps.if: the customer has not already chosen a savings account earlier in this conversation
steps.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

open_questions: The documents do not say how the checking-account notice period (e.g. 3 days for mid tier) affects the close_bank_account_7392 call: close now and only disclose it, or schedule the closure. This workflow discloses it and proceeds.

The debit card procedure requires a card to have been active for 14 days before it can be closed, and lists only lost/stolen/fraud as exemptions. The documents do not say whether that blocks closing a checking account whose card is newer than 14 days.
The parameters of close_bank_account_7392 are not documented beyond the account to close. The agent should read them after unlocking the tool.
The account record has no documented field for 'collections'. The agent can only judge it from the status and balance values returned.

info.about: features the customer wants, such as a relationship or loyalty bonus, compounding frequency, ATM fee rebates, savings goals tracking, eco features or a premium tier
info.ask: Which features matter most to you, for example interest bonuses, how often interest compounds, ATM fee rebates, or savings goal tools?

info.about: the savings product the customer confirms, written as its full official name ending with 'Account'
info.ask: Would you like me to open the [recommended] Account for you?

info.about: whether the customer wants the agent to transfer the opening deposit from checking now, and the amount
info.ask: Would you like me to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account now?

info.about: whether the customer also wants to close a checking account in this conversation

steps.do: Ask for the customer's name and two identity details. Look the customer up with get_user_information_by_name (exact, case-sensitive name), get_user_information_by_email or get_user_information_by_id, using what the customer gave. Do not share any account information before the customer is verified.

args.customer_name: as stated by the customer (or email / user_id with the matching lookup tool)

steps.quote: Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

steps.do: Decide whether at least 2 of the date of birth, email, phone number and address the customer gave match the record. If they do not match, do not continue. Ask again or explain that you cannot proceed.
steps.quote: Customer identity is verified in our systems.

steps.do: Get the current time. It is used for the verification log and for the account-tenure checks.
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days.

steps.do: Log the verification with the record's name, user_id, address, email, phone number and date of birth, and the current time.
steps.if: the customer matched at least 2 identity details in verify
steps.quote: Customer identity is verified in our systems.

steps.do: Unlock get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 and call it for the verified user. Read each account's account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance and date_opened.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Check every eligibility item: (a) the customer has at least one active checking account; (b) at least one active checking account has date_opened 14 or more days before the current time; (c) the customer has fewer than 5 personal savings accounts; (d) no account is in collections or has a negative balance. If any item fails, stop and use the matching failure step.
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: Tell the customer they already have the maximum number of personal savings accounts and that a new one cannot be opened. Stop.
steps.if: the customer already holds 5 personal savings accounts
steps.quote: If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, do not open a new one. Inform the customer they have reached the maximum.

steps.do: Tell the customer the date they become eligible: the earliest checking account's date_opened plus 14 days. Do not open the account.
steps.if: no active checking account has been open 14 or more days (or the customer has no active checking account)
steps.quote: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

steps.do: Explain that the account in collections or with a negative balance must be resolved before a savings account can be opened. Do not proceed.
steps.if: any account is in collections or has a negative balance
steps.quote: Resolve these issues first; do not proceed until all accounts are in good standing.

steps.do: If the customer also wants to close a checking account, open the savings account first and close the checking account afterwards. Eligibility depends on an active checking account held at least 14 days. Closing first can remove the only qualifying account, for example when the remaining checking account is under 14 days old. If the customer asks to close first, explain this reason; do not just insist.
steps.if: the customer also asked to close a checking account in this conversation
steps.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days.

steps.do: Ask about the customer's savings needs: monthly withdrawal count, the balance they can keep, and the features they want (relationship bonus, compounding, ATM fee rebates, savings goals tracking, and any other preference). Collect every need before recommending.
steps.if: all eligibility items passed
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Compare every personal savings product against all of the customer's needs, using the product rules below: free withdrawals, ongoing minimum balance, compounding, relationship bonus, ATM rebates, goals tracking, and linked-checking boosts based on the checking accounts the customer will keep. Recommend the ONE account that meets every hard requirement. Treat preferences that conflict with hard requirements (for example 'premium' tiers whose minimum balance exceeds what the customer can keep, or eco products with too few free withdrawals) as unmet, and say why.
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Confirm the customer's choice and record the full official account_class name ending in 'Account' (for example 'Silver Plus Account').
steps.quote: note: account_class must use the full official name ending with 'Account', e.g., 'Silver Plus Account', 'Gold Account'

steps.do: Unlock open_bank_account_4821 and call it with the verified user_id, account_type 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.
steps.if: all eligibility checks passed and the customer confirmed the account_class
steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Ask whether the customer wants you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now, and tell them the product's minimum opening deposit.
steps.if: open_account succeeded
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: Unlock transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291. Transfer the confirmed amount from the customer's OPEN checking account to the new savings account. Before calling, check that the source balance covers the amount. On an insufficient-funds error, offer to adjust the amount or use a different source account.

args.source_account_id: checking account from get_accounts chosen with the customer
args.amount: opening deposit amount confirmed with the customer

steps.if: the customer says yes to an immediate transfer and the source account is ACTIVE/OPEN with sufficient funds
steps.quote: If yes, use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount.

steps.do: Tell the customer they have 30 days to fund the account by internal transfer or external deposit, or the account will be closed.
steps.if: the customer declines the immediate transfer
steps.quote: If no, inform them they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

steps.do: Give the new account details and confirm either the funding status or the 30-day funding deadline. If the customer also asked to close a checking account, continue with closing_personal_checking_accounts.
steps.quote: Provide the new account details and confirm the funding status or the funding deadline.

steps.do: If a tool returns a system error that prevents opening, ask the customer whether they want a human agent. Transfer only if they agree, with reason technical_system_error.

args.summary: what was attempted and the error

steps.if: open_account (or another required tool) returns a system error that cannot be resolved and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request

rules.rule: Eligibility: verified customer; at least one active checking account; fewer than 5 personal savings accounts; no collections or negative balances; a checking account held at least 14 days.
rules.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: 15 free withdrawals/month, $2,500 ongoing minimum, $1,000 opening deposit, daily compounding.
rules.quote: You have up to 15 free withdrawals each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account minimum balance is $2,500.
rules.quote: Keep your balance at or above $2,500 to meet the ongoing requirement.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account opening deposit is $1,000.
rules.quote: Fund your new account with at least $1,000 to open it.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account has a 0.025% relationship APY bonus.
rules.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account rebates ATM fees up to 25 per month.
rules.quote: Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account has built-in savings goals tracking. No other personal savings document lists this feature.
rules.quote: Use the integrated goals tool to set targets, monitor progress, and visualize how contributions accelerate over time.

rules.rule: Silver Account allows 10 free withdrawals per cycle; extra withdrawals may incur fees.
rules.quote: Track your withdrawal activity; transactions beyond 10 in a cycle may incur an excess withdrawal fee as described in your account disclosures.

rules.rule: Bronze Account allows 6 free withdrawals per month.
rules.quote: Free withdrawals per month: 6

rules.rule: Green Account (savings) allows 8 withdrawals per month; 15 only with an EcoCard.
rules.quote: Plan withdrawals to stay within 8 each month.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings) reaches 15 free withdrawals and gets ATM rebates only for EcoCard holders.
rules.quote: Increased monthly free withdrawals: 8 + 7 = 15 total free withdrawals per month

rules.rule: Gold Account requires a $10,000 ongoing minimum.
rules.quote: Ongoing minimum balance: $10,000

rules.rule: Gold Plus Account requires a $25,000 minimum.
rules.quote: Maintain a balance of at least $25,000 to keep account benefits active.

rules.rule: Platinum Account requires a $50,000 minimum.
rules.quote: Ongoing minimum balance to maintain account benefits: $50,000

rules.rule: Platinum Plus Account requires a $100,000 minimum.
rules.quote: Minimum balance to maintain the account: $100,000

rules.rule: Diamond Elite Account requires a $250,000 minimum.
rules.quote: Minimum balance to maintain the account: $250,000.

rules.rule: Only the listed checking/savings pairings get a linked APY boost (for example, Blue Account checking + Silver Plus Account savings). Count only checking accounts the customer will keep.
rules.quote: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

rules.rule: Blue Account checking gives +0.35% on a linked Silver Plus Account.
rules.quote: When linked to a Silver Plus Savings Account: +0.35% APY boost

rules.rule: Checking-account boosts do not stack; only the highest applies.
rules.quote: Only the HIGHEST checking account APY boost is applied to the savings account.

rules.rule: Transfers require both accounts ACTIVE/OPEN and enough funds in the source account.
rules.quote: Both the source and destination accounts must be in ACTIVE or OPEN status.

draft.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, eligibility was checked against get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, and the confirmed savings account was opened with open_bank_account_4821. Funding was either transferred at the customer's request or the 30-day deadline was stated. If the customer also asked to close a checking account, that job follows.

when.quote: Verify all of the following before closing:

starts.note: customer: only when the customer explicitly asks to close a checking account.
starts.quote: Customer is explicitly requesting to close their account

tools.not_used: Verification is done and logged in the first job (opening_personal_savings_accounts). Re-run those verify/log steps only if the customer has not been verified in this conversation.

info.about: which checking account (by product name or last digits) the customer wants closed
info.ask: Which checking account would you like to close?

info.about: the customer accepts any early closure fee and the notice period
info.ask: Do you want to proceed with the closure given these terms?

info.about: where any remaining balance should be moved before closure
info.ask: Your account still has a balance. Which of your accounts should I move it to before closing?

steps.do: If the customer is not already verified and logged in this conversation, run the identify, verify, get_time and log_verification steps from opening_personal_savings_accounts first.
steps.if: the customer has not been verified in this conversation
steps.quote: Verify all of the following before closing:

steps.do: Unlock (if not already unlocked) and call get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 for the verified user to read the target account's account_id, account_class, status, balance and date_opened.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get the current time to compute how long the account has been open.
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: Unlock get_bank_account_transactions_9173 and call it for the target checking account. Look for any transaction with status 'pending'.
steps.quote: Transaction status, either 'posted' or 'pending'

steps.do: Check the following. (1) Status must be OPEN. (2) There must be no pending transactions. (3) Find the tier and fee from account_class and days since date_opened: Entry tier is $15 within 30 days, notice 0 days. Mid tier (Blue Account, Green Account (checking)) is $25 within 60 days, notice 3 days. Premium tier (Evergreen Account) is $50 within 90 days, notice 7 days. Elite tier (Bluest Account) is $100 within 180 days, notice 14 days. (4) If a fee applies, the balance must be at least the fee; otherwise the balance must be exactly $0. If status is not OPEN or a transaction is pending, explain what must be resolved and stop.
steps.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

steps.do: With the customer's authorization, unlock transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 and move the balance (minus any applicable fee) to another of the customer's OPEN accounts. If the customer declines, explain the closure cannot proceed until the balance requirement is met.

args.destination_account_id: another OPEN account of the customer, chosen by the customer
args.amount: balance minus applicable fee (or full balance if no fee)

steps.if: the balance is above $0 when no fee applies (or above the fee when one applies) and the customer authorizes the transfer
steps.quote: Consolidating balances prior to closing one of the customer’s accounts

steps.do: Tell the customer the balance must be at least the early closure fee, because the fee can only be taken from the account balance. Stop until it is funded.
steps.if: a fee applies and the balance is below the fee
steps.quote: The fee is deducted directly from the account balance and there is no alternative payment method.

steps.do: Tell the customer any applicable early closure fee and the tier's notice period, and get their confirmation to proceed.
steps.if: all pre-closure requirements are met
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: Unlock get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 and list the debit cards on the target checking account.
steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: For each card with status ACTIVE or PENDING, unlock close_debit_card_4721 and close it with reason 'account_closing'. Do this only if the card's requirements hold: no pending transactions or refunds, and active at least 14 days from date_issued. If a card cannot be closed, explain what must be resolved and do not close the account.
steps.if: the target checking account has a debit card in ACTIVE or PENDING status and the customer confirmed the closure
steps.quote: If the linked checking account is being closed, all associated debit cards must be closed first

steps.do: Unlock close_bank_account_7392 and close the target checking account.
steps.if: status is OPEN, there are no pending transactions, the balance requirement is met, any linked debit cards are closed, and the customer confirmed after hearing the fee and notice terms
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

steps.do: Confirm the closure and any fee deducted. If the closure returns error 903, tell the customer to wait 48 hours and try again.
steps.quote: This can occur when attempting to close an account. Instruct the customer to wait 48 hours and try again.

steps.do: If closure cannot be completed because of a system error, or the customer insists on a human agent after you have offered help, ask before transferring. Use reason account_closure_request.

args.summary: closure request and what blocked it

steps.if: the closure cannot be completed by the agent and the customer agrees to a transfer
steps.quote: Customer is explicitly requesting to close their account

rules.rule: Account status must be OPEN.
rules.quote: Account status is OPEN

rules.rule: There must be no pending transactions on the account.
rules.quote: No pending transactions for this account

rules.rule: Mid tier (Blue Account, Green Account (checking)): $25 fee if closed within 60 days; 3-day notice.
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $25 if closed within 60 days

rules.rule: Entry tier (Light Blue Account, Light Green Account, Green Fee-Free Account): $15 fee if closed within 30 days.
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $15 if closed within 30 days

rules.rule: Premium tier (Evergreen Account): $50 fee if closed within 90 days.
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $50 if closed within 90 days

rules.rule: Elite tier (Bluest Account): $100 fee if closed within 180 days.
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $100 if closed within 180 days

rules.rule: The balance must be $0 when no fee applies, or at least the fee when one does.
rules.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

rules.rule: Debit cards on a checking account being closed must be closed first.
rules.quote: If the linked checking account is being closed, all associated debit cards must be closed first

draft.done_when: Pre-closure checks passed: status OPEN, no pending transactions, balance requirement met. The customer heard and accepted any fee and the notice period. Linked active debit cards were closed. close_bank_account_7392 succeeded and the closure was confirmed to the customer, or the blocking issue was explained.
